source.value: Rippers Unmasked — Core Rulebook v1.1 (Soaring Strike)

summary.value: The wind carries your strikes across the battlefield.

system.description: The wind carries your strikes across the battlefield. You may perform a free attack with a melee weapon you have equipped; this attack may target creatures that cannot normally be targeted by melee attacks. If you used a weapon belonging to the brawling, spear, or sword Category for this attack, it deals 5 extra damage. If you hit a flying target with this attack, you may force them to land immediately.
